group.desc: SAX Power Home/Home Plus vendor-specific Immediate Controls block, as documented in the SAX Power Modbus-TCP SUNSPEC-Mode documentation. This is a reduced variant of the standard SunSpec model 123 -- it only exposes a percentage power setpoint, a timeout, and a control-mode switch, plus the reference power the percentage is relative to. To command a power level independent of smart-meter zero-export regulation, set Steuermodus/CtrlMode to SETPOINT (1) first, then write the percentage. After the timeout elapses (300s max, or the value written to Tms) the device reverts to smart-meter zero-export control. Registers 40047-40053, Slave-ID 100, Port 502.
group.label: Immediate Controls - SAX Power variant
group.name: controls_sax

points.desc: Model length as documented by SAX Power (register count as printed in the vendor documentation; the listed point table below only accounts for 5 registers after this one, addresses 40049-40053)
points.label: Model Length
points.name: L

points.label: Power Setpoint Percent
points.name: WSetPct
points.detail: Register 40049. Range -100*SF to +100*SF, relative to WMaxRef. Only takes effect once CtrlMode is set to SETPOINT (1).

points.label: Setpoint Timeout
points.name: Tms
points.detail: Register 40050. After this many seconds without a refresh, control reverts to smart-meter zero-export regulation. Maximum 300 seconds; defaults to 300s if not explicitly set.

points.label: Control Mode
points.name: CtrlMode
points.detail: Register 40051 -- 0: SmartMeter Nullregelung, 1: Sollwertvorgabe. Must be set to SETPOINT before WSetPct takes effect.

points.label: Max Power Reference
points.name: WMaxRef
points.detail: Register 40053. Reference point for 100% power. Documented well-known values: 4600 / 9200 / 13800 W, depending on device variant.
